summary: Verified Railway greenlet dependency fix at app level. Backend boots cleanly, /api/status returns healthy JSON (database connected, 62 tables, bot & admin configured, all 7 integrations OK). Frontend dashboard renders all data-testid checks with expected green statuses. Read-only checks only, per instruction.
critical_code_review_comments: Old backend.err.log lines show a prior 'ModuleNotFoundError: psycopg' during a reload before current healthy boot; current process is fine but confirm requirements pin psycopg[binary] for production/Railway to prevent regressions similar to greenlet.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth required for status/dashboard checks
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/status is the smoke test that exercises the SQLAlchemy async import chain (greenlet). Frontend dashboard testids: lockbay-dashboard, status-banner, check-database, check-tables, check-bot-token. Preview is server-only (no Telegram bot); do NOT write to the production PostgreSQL.
rca of the issue: Railway build succeeded but runtime crashed because sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio requires the 'greenlet' C extension, which is not auto-installed unless the 'asyncio' extra is requested. Fix: requirements.txt updated to 'sqlalchemy[asyncio]>=2.0.41,<2.1' plus explicit 'greenlet>=3.0.0'. App-level verification here confirms no regression in preview.
